select count(*) as fill_events,
       count(t.trade_id) as matched_to_trade,
       count(*) filter (where t.count_fp >= 3) as print_ge3,
       count(*) filter (where t.count_fp < 3) as print_lt3,
       min(f.received_at)::date as first_day, max(f.received_at)::date as last_day,
       percentile_disc(0.5) within group (order by t.count_fp) as median_print
  from execution_fill_events f
  join live_orders o on o.kalshi_order_id = f.kalshi_order_id
  left join execution_trade_events t on t.trade_id = f.trade_id
 where o.strategy = 'Fmmsell10' and o.action = 'buy' and o.side = 'no'
